portal_hypertension.abstract: To evaluate the feasibility and efficacy of Laparoscopy-Assisted mesenteric vein access for portal vein recanalization-transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (LAmTIPS) in patients with symptomatic portal hypertension and Cavernous Transformation. A total of five patients (5 male, mean age: 41.4 years; range, 15-63 years) with chronic portal vein thrombosis (PVT) complicated by cavernous transformation of the portal vein (CTPV) were included in this study. portal_hypertension.title: Propofol pharmacodynamics in a pregnant patient with portal hypertension: a case report.
portal_hypertension.authors: Lacassie HJ, Cortínez LI, Gálvez A
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：本病例报告描述了一名患有严重合并症、接受选择性非产科手术的妊娠晚期孕妇使用 Eleveld 药代动力学-药效模型进行靶控异丙酚麻醉。 临床提示：一名31岁女性，孕35周，因胃绕道术后门静脉血栓继发门静脉高压，在全凭静脉麻醉下行内镜下食管静脉曲张套扎术。
portal_hypertension.abstract: This case report describes target-controlled propofol anesthesia using the Eleveld pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic model in a third-trimester pregnant woman with significant comorbidity undergoing elective non-obstetric surgery. A 31-year-old woman, 35 weeks pregnant with portal hypertension secondary to portal vein thrombosis after gastric bypass, underwent endoscopic esophageal variceal ligation under total intravenous anesthesia with remifentanil and propofol, guided by Bispectral Index monitoring. portal_hypertension.title: The value of hepatic venous pressure gradient in patients with pyrrolidine alkaloid-induced hepatic sinusoidal obstruction syndrome.
portal_hypertension.journal: Journal of gastrointestinal surgery : official journal of the Society for Surgery of the Alimentary Tract
portal_hypertension.authors: Cai Z, Li R, Zhang F
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：吡咯烷生物碱诱导的肝窦阻塞综合征（PA-HSOS）的特点是快速进行性门静脉高压。 临床提示：肝静脉压力梯度（HVPG）是诊断窦性门静脉高压的金标准。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Pyrrolidine alkaloid-induced hepatic sinusoidal obstruction syndrome (PA-HSOS) is characterized by rapidly progressive portal hypertension. Hepatic venous pressure gradient (HVPG) is the gold standard for the diagnosis of sinusoidal portal hypertension. However, the role of HVPG in evaluating disease severity and treatment choice in patients with PA-HSOS needs further verification. This study aimed to investigate the clinical value of HVPG in patients with PA-HSOS. Patients who were diagnosed with PA-HSOS according to the "Nanjing criteria" and received HVPG measurements in our hospital between January 2016 and April 2020 were retrospectively reviewed. portal_hypertension.title: Unmet needs in diagnosis and management of portopulmonary hypertension: How far have we reached?
portal_hypertension.authors: Krowka MJ, DuBrock HM, Raevens S
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：医疗管理与肝移植相结合，为POPH“治愈”提供了独特的机会；然而，移植风险可能很大，因为它与 POPH 的严重程度有关。 临床提示：除了最近的 POPH 实践指南外，还可以建议继续努力提高我们对预后因素的理解，研究新的治疗方法并改善 POPH 的结果。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portopulmonary hypertension (POPH), a form of pulmonary artery hypertension, occurs because of portal hypertension. Pulmonary hemodynamics and right heart function are key entities that are considered when diagnosing and treating POPH. Medical management, combined with liver transplantation, offers a unique opportunity for POPH "cure"; however, transplant risk can be significant as it relates to the severity of POPH. In addition to recent POPH practice guidelines, continued efforts can be suggested to improve our understanding of prognostic factors, investigate newer medical treatments, and improve outcomes of POPH. portal_hypertension.title: A machine learning approach to non-invasive prediction of hepatic decompensation in compensated advanced chronic liver disease: the CIRI model.
portal_hypertension.authors: Kramer G, Hildeman A, Tozzi C
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：我们开发并验证了肝硬化风险识别器 (CIRI) 模型，这是一种机器学习工具，使用 11 个人口统计和常规实验室参数进行训练，用于预测首次失代偿；并将其性能与 HVPG、肝硬度 m 进行基准测试 临床提示：肝静脉压力梯度（HVPG）是评估代偿性晚期慢性肝病（cACLD）预后的金标准，但其侵入性限制了广泛的临床应用。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Hepatic venous pressure gradient (HVPG) is the gold standard for assessment of prognosis in compensated advanced chronic liver disease (cACLD), yet its invasiveness limits broad clinical use. We developed and validated the Cirrhosis Risk Identifier (CIRI) model, a machine-learning tool using 11 demographic and routine laboratory parameters trained to prognosticate first decompensation; and benchmarked its performance against HVPG, liver stiffness measurement (LSM), FIB-4 and MELD. cACLD patients were identified in the U.S. Optum Clinformatics Data Mart (Optum CDM) for model development and internal validation and externally validated in a prospective European tertiary care cohort.
